messages:
Priya: Drafted the region provisioning runbook for eu-central-3. Focused on Pulumi modules -> TF state handoff, CI wiring, and the validation checklist. PTAL: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-central-3 (draft)
Ken: Nice. Can you call out the GPU SKU limits per AZ? last time we hit quota errors on p3dn.24xlarge equivalents.
Priya: Good call. Added SKU table and quota request commands. Example: `aws service-quotas request-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 10` (for g4dn-style SKUs)
Maya: How are you handling state backend during the pulumi -> terraform transition? we need zero-downtime state moves for the infra state.
Priya: Plan is: create new TF state bucket (encrypted) and use a short-lived statebridge lambda to copy Pulumi stack exports into TF remote state format, with locking via DynamoDB. Steps in runbook under "State handoff".
Ravi: Put a strong warning about access keys. Use IAM role assumption only. No long-lived creds in CI. Also locktable name and bucket name must be unique to region.
Priya: Yep - CI uses role assumption: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/eng-ci-eu-central-3` and the pipeline exports temporary creds. Added example.
Sam: For network validation, add automated checks: BGP routes, SG rules for GKE/eks node ports, private link endpoints, and cross-account VPC peering. We should fail the pipeline if NAT gateway count < expected.
Priya: Done. Validation script snippets: ```
# simple check
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=eu-central-3a | jq '.NetworkInterfaces | length'
``` will be used in the post-provision step.
Elena: Cost question: did you include an estimate for on-demand GPU vs reserved burst pools? finance asked for monthly worst-case and steady-state buckets.
Priya: Yes — table with three scenarios (dev, steady, peak) and recommended reserved capacity purchase for steady-state. Also added guidance for autoscaling policies and burst to hosted to reduce spend.
ops-bot: Note: quota-checker ran for eu-central-3 — missing 2 GPU vCPU quotas (filed request 1723456700-req) :raised_hands:
Ken: One more — can the pulumi modules emit tags required by billing pipeline? We need `cost-center` and `env` everywhere.
Priya: Pulumi modules now emit `redwood:cost-center` and `redwood:env`. Confirmed with tagging tests in CI.
Maya: CI wiring: add a manual approval gate before the state handoff job. Also add a fast rollback path that points consumers to the fallback region (eu-west-1) if health checks fail.
Priya: Added a canary rollout section: create canary cluster with 10% traffic, run perf/latency probes (end-to-end), then cutover. Rollback uses DNS weight switch + autoscaling down. Docs include commands and `kubectl` snippets.
Ravi: For the handoff meeting, I can take the oncall rotation for the first 72h. We should schedule a 30m sync with SRE, Networking, and Finance after provisioning.
Priya: Thanks all — I'll mark the runbook ready for review and send calendar invites. If anyone has minor edits push to the branch `infra/eu-central-3-runbook`.
Sam: LGTM from infra. I'll add a quick post-provision health dashboard (latency, GPU util, OOM events) to Console.
Elena: Finance approves the cost table, will include in the chargeback doc.
Priya: Closing note: remember to delete test buckets and temp lock tables in teardown. Commands included in the teardown section. :white_check_mark:
